title: Timer
description: A list of timed reminders that announces them through the speech synthesizer.
versionOrder: Disk saves have no recorded order or dates beyond their source comments. Any ordering here is a presentation guess.

versions.label: TIMER.BAS (More Voice)
versions.note: Uses the disk clock and PRINT* speech, which is not emulated.
versions.unavailableReason: Preserved as source. It is not offered as a player.
versions.startupSource:
1 CLS
2 CLEAR 999
10 T=0
100 PRINT@64,"";:IF T=0 THEN 200 ELSE FOR A=1 TO T
110 IF TIME$>= T$(A) THEN PRINT @ 960,T$(A), ELSE 130
115 PRINT*"TIME TIME TIME TIME TIME"
120 PRINT*P$(A);
121 PRINT P$(A);
125 T$(A)=T$(T):P$(A)=P$(T):T=T-1
130 PRINT T$(A),P$(A):IF T$(A)<T$(A-1) THEN T$=T$(A):T$(A)=T$(A-1):T$(A-1)=T$:T$=P$(A):P$(A)=P$(A-1):P$(A-1)=T$NEXT A
145 NEXT A
200 PRINT @0,TIME$

attribution.text: From a recovered disk; the source names no author. Preserved here for small-scale archival use.
